name: ViMo code
notes: The README describes ViMo as a GUI world model that predicts the next GUI state as image and text. UI_text_prediction.py runs the text-prediction step with Gemini (gemini-2.0-flash), with a GPT-4o variant in the same file. data/ holds the selected Android in the Wild and AndroidControl episode IDs with annotations; images must be downloaded from the original releases, then generate_ocr.py and check_fix.py prepare the symbolic text representation. Graphic prediction is trained by following the InstructPix2Pix project, with edit_cli.py and generate.yaml for inference; no trained weights are in the repository. 'ViMo-Empowered Agent' is a copy of AndroidWorld (with its own Apache-2.0 LICENSE) whose vimo modules post the current screenshot and a candidate action to a world-model server and score the predicted screen when choosing actions. The README does not cite the paper; the project page links this repository and arXiv 2504.13936. No license file is at the repository root. Code was read, not run.
summary: Code for the ViMo GUI world model: Gemini-based next-screen text prediction, AITW and AndroidControl data processing, InstructPix2Pix-style graphic inference, and an AndroidWorld agent that consults it.
